summary: The one-line manifest repair aligns the canonical tool name with the unchanged LangChain registration. Current validation reports valid with zero diagnostics, direct TypeScript checking passes, and Git evidence shows only moldea/moldea.yaml changed. This evaluation modified no files.

requirements.evidence: The actor identifies reconciliation of the canonical declaration with registered name `lookup_order`. The manifest diff proves the prior declaration was `find_order`, while src/agent.ts closes registration to `[lookupOrderTool]` and src/tools.ts defines that tool as `lookup_order`.

moldea/moldea.yaml now declares `name: lookup_order`; the Git diff shows the sole change from `find_order`. Workspace hashes and Git status show the runtime source remained unchanged, and current validation returns `valid: true` with `diagnosticCount: 0`.

The manifest bindings exactly resolve to supportAgent and loadSupportInstruction in src/agent.ts, SupportOutputSchema and LookupOrderInputSchema in src/contracts.ts, lookupOrder in src/implementations.ts, and lookupOrderTool in src/tools.ts. Source consumption confirms the instruction loader, providerStrategy output schema, implementation/schema-backed tool declaration, and `[lookupOrderTool]` registration. Workspace assertions show these files unchanged; current TypeScript checking succeeds.
